titles.title: The Park at Night

description: Dark trees stand on a rolling green hill in this semiabstract composition. The trees contrast with a vibrant red sunset visible behind them. Overhead, the sky has already turned a dark shade of blue.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
